## Synthesis

PRA Psykiatrisk Klinik - Rønde is a psychiatric clinic in Rønde, Denmark, that appears in the Danish ADHD-databasen (ADHD Database) 2024 report as one of the units measured against national quality indicators for ADHD treatment. The clinic is named twice in the report, in connection with two separate performance indicators, and its results illustrate the sharp variation in quality-target achievement documented across Danish clinics that year.

On Indicator 10 — which measures, for the first time ever reported, the share of adult treatment courses in which a patient's need for social support was assessed within 120 days of starting treatment — PRA Psykiatrisk Klinik - Rønde recorded 15 out of 67 eligible courses meeting the standard, a fulfillment rate of 22 percent (confidence interval 13–34) [^src1]. This falls far short of the national development target of 90 percent, and is also below the national average of 37 percent reported for this indicator in 2024 [^src1]. The clinic's poor result on Indicator 10 is highlighted as the entity's central significance in the dataset [^src1].

By contrast, on a separate measure — recorded on page 56 of the same report, in the section covering Indicator 11 (adult patients in ADHD medication treatment within 120 days of starting a package course) — the clinic achieved a markedly higher rate: 56 out of 67 courses met the standard, a fulfillment rate of 84 percent (confidence interval 73–92) [^src2]. This places the clinic well above some other regions; the surrounding report context notes, for example, that Region Hovedstaden scored only 37 percent on this same indicator nationally, compared with Region Nordjylland's 85 percent, with the variation attributed largely to differences in registration practice rather than real clinical differences [^src2].

Taken together, the two figures show a clinic performing very differently across two distinct quality dimensions of ADHD care in the same reporting year: badly on the newly introduced social-support-assessment indicator, but comparatively well on the medication-treatment-timing indicator. The broader ADHD Database steering group discussed the underlying causes of the low national fulfillment on Indicator 10, including registration practices and data quality issues from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, and resolved to work on improving registration practice going forward [^src1].

## Claims

- PRA Psykiatrisk Klinik - Rønde achieved 22% fulfillment (15/67, confidence interval 13–34) on Indicator 10, measuring assessment of adult patients' social support needs within 120 days of treatment start, significantly below the 90% development target [^src1].
- PRA Psykiatrisk Klinik - Rønde achieved 84% fulfillment (56/67, confidence interval 73–92) on Indicator 11, measuring adult patients in ADHD medication treatment within 120 days of starting a package course [^src2].
